en.headline: Siobhan Haughey wins Asian Games 100m freestyle gold
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 52.45 seconds in Tokyo to take her second individual gold of the Games, less than 24 hours after defending the 200m freestyle title.
body: Siobhan Haughey won the women's 100 metres freestyle gold at the Asian Games in Tokyo on Tuesday, clocking 52.45 seconds to claim her second individual title of the Games.

China's Yu Yiting took silver in 53.21 seconds and compatriot Cheng Yujie bronze in 53.47. Haughey had earlier posted the fastest heat time of 53.60 seconds and entered the final as favourite after defending her 200m freestyle crown on Monday.
The victory adds to Hong Kong's growing medal haul in the pool and on the track at the Aichi-Nagoya Games. Haughey is expected to contest further freestyle events later in the meet.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運女子百米自由泳奪金
zh.dek: 何詩蓓在東京以52秒45奪得女子100米自由泳金牌，距周一衛冕200米自由泳金牌不足24小時，今屆個人第二金。
body: 香港泳手何詩蓓周二在亞運女子100米自由泳決賽以52秒45奪金，成為今屆個人第二枚金牌。
中國的余依婷以53秒21奪銀，程玉潔以53秒47獲銅。何詩蓓早前初賽以53秒60錄得最快時間晉級，周一剛衛冕200米自由泳金牌。
港隊在本屆亞運游泳項目再添金牌，何詩蓓稍後仍有其他自由泳項目賽事。
